title: Kenyan Beef Lasagna
community: Urban Kenya — the family and hotel restaurant favourite
author: Mama Wanjiru
desc: Kenyan Beef Lasagna — layers of fresh pasta sheets, richly spiced Kenyan beef bolognese, and creamy béchamel, baked until bubbling and golden. A restaurant staple that has become a home celebration dish — the family meal that feeds a crowd beautifully.
longDesc: Lasagna has become one of Kenya's most beloved baked pasta dishes — served at hotel buffets, family celebrations, and restaurant menus across the country. The Kenyan version uses aromatic spices in the bolognese and adds paprika to the béchamel for character.
steps: Make bolognese: cook onion and garlic in oil. Add beef — brown thoroughly. Add tomato paste, tomatoes, spices, and salt. Simmer 25 minutes until thick.
Make béchamel: melt butter. Add flour — cook 1 minute. Whisk in milk gradually until smooth. Simmer until thick. Season with paprika, nutmeg, and salt.
Layer in baking dish: béchamel, lasagna sheets, bolognese, béchamel, sheets, bolognese — repeat.
Bake covered with foil for 30 minutes. Uncover. Bake 15 more until golden and bubbling.
chefTips: A thick bolognese is essential — wet meat sauce makes the lasagna watery.
The béchamel must be well seasoned — it provides the background flavour of every bite.
Rest before cutting — this allows the lasagna to set and cuts cleanly.
cookingScience: The béchamel (made from a roux) contains a starch gel that absorbs excess moisture from the bolognese during baking, preventing the common soggy lasagna problem. The foil for the first 30 minutes creates a steaming environment that cooks the pasta through; removing the foil for the final 15 minutes dries the surface and creates the golden crust.
sustainabilityTips: Kenyan minced beef and local dairy for the béchamel.
healthBenefits: High protein from beef and cheese.
Best enjoyed as a celebration dish.
culturalNote: Beef lasagna has become a quintessential family celebration dish in urban Kenya — the dish that mothers spend an afternoon making for a family return or graduation dinner.
